item.summary: The Department for Promotion of Industry and Internal Trade (DPIIT), Ministry of Commerce and Industry, has driven a sustained shift from a permission-based to a trust-based regulatory framework. Reforms across the startup ecosystem, compliance reduction, sectoral regulation, foreign direct investment and single-window clearances have reduced the regulatory burden on businesses and delivered…
item.title: DPIIT Advances Trust-Based Governance Through Startup Support, Regulatory Reforms and Digital Single-Window Clearances
